items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Billy Strayhorn was one of the most brilliant men I've ever known... Billy Strayhorn would have been successful... Billy was satisfied to stay with Duke all those years... I suppose for the same reason I stayed with Duke

ctx.x: Billy Strayhorn -- I think it was 1939 when Billy Strayhorn joined Duke, right?
